connector.name: Lore Context
connector.registryDescription: Governed AI-agent memory, Evidence Ledger traces, evals, and portable context tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lore-context account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
